pickConnection: Pick a connection for this tab.
runHint: Run the selection or the statement under the cursor (Ctrl+Enter)

results.empty: Write a query and press Ctrl+Enter.
results.accessibleTruncated: {{value}}… Open the cell viewer for the full value.

export.hint: Export to a file: the loaded rows, a selection, or every row

results.sortWhenComplete: The result can be sorted once every row has arrived
results.filterHint: Rows where some cell contains this text (any case). Copy and export follow the filter.
results.filterPageHint: This filters only the current page. Use WHERE above to filter the whole table.
results.filterLocked: Finish the current operation or apply or discard pending changes before filtering.
results.filterWhenComplete: The result can be filtered once every row has arrived
results.customFilterHint: Conditions add up (AND) and follow SQL: NULL only matches IS NULL. Numbers compare by value; text ignores case. LIKE uses % and _.
results.copyColumnInList: Copy all values as SQL IN list
results.copiedInList: Copied the values of {{column}} as an IN list
results.findWhenComplete: The result can be searched once every row has arrived

messages.connectionLost: The connection was lost: {{detail}}. Nothing ran. Reconnect, then run it again: nothing is re-run on its own.
messages.idleClosed: The connection was closed after {{minutes}} min without use, as its connection type asks. Nothing ran. Reconnect, then run it again: nothing is re-run on its own.
messages.statementOk: Statement {{index}}: OK ({{duration}} ms: {{execution}} ms execute, {{fetch}} ms fetch)
messages.statementRows_one: Statement {{index}}: {{formattedCount}} row ({{duration}} ms: {{execution}} ms execute, {{fetch}} ms fetch)
messages.statementRows_other: Statement {{index}}: {{formattedCount}} rows ({{duration}} ms: {{execution}} ms execute, {{fetch}} ms fetch)
messages.summary_one: {{formattedCount}} statement: {{ok}} OK, {{failed}} failed, {{notRun}} not run ({{execution}} ms execute, {{fetch}} ms fetch)
messages.summary_other: {{formattedCount}} statements: {{ok}} OK, {{failed}} failed, {{notRun}} not run ({{execution}} ms execute, {{fetch}} ms fetch)

stop.transactionAborted: Statement {{index}} aborted the transaction: the server will only roll it back, so the rest was not run. Roll back, then run the rest again.
stop.transactionRolledBack: Statement {{index}} rolled back the transaction, so the rest was not run: it would have run without the statements before it.
stop.closed: The tab closed while statement {{index}}'s error waited for an answer.

messages.paused: Statement {{index}} failed: waiting for your answer.

history.title: Query history
history.privacyHelp: SQL is saved locally. Turn off saving for a connection in its “⋯” menu before running SQL with secrets. Previous entries are kept.
history.connectionUnavailable: Connection unavailable. Choose one after opening.
history.preferenceHint: Saves SQL locally for this connection. Disable before running SQL with passwords or other secrets. Previous history is kept.

viewer.title: Cell value
viewer.selectCell: Select a cell to see its value.
viewer.editHint: Save changes from the results toolbar.
viewer.pendingEdit: Change pending; save it from the results toolbar.

formatHint: Format the selection or the whole script (Shift+Alt+F)

snippets.title: Saved queries
snippets.help: Saved on this computer, for this repository (or for every one when saved outside a repository). Saving with an existing name replaces it.
snippets.empty: No saved queries yet. Ctrl+S in an editor tab saves its SQL.
snippets.saveHint: Save this SQL as a named query (Ctrl+S)
snippets.name: Name

table.countHint: Count the rows the filter keeps (SELECT COUNT(*))

queryPaging.label: Query result pages
queryPaging.hint: Scroll to fetch more rows. Grid filters and sorting affect loaded rows only; use WHERE and ORDER BY in SQL for the full query.
queryPaging.filterLoaded: The grid filter and sort apply only to loaded rows. Use WHERE and ORDER BY in SQL for the full query.
queryPaging.clearView: Clear the local sort and filters to fetch more rows.
queryPaging.countHint: Count all rows returned by this query
queryPaging.countFailed: The query count is not available.

edit.closeUnsaved: There are unsaved row changes. Discard them and close this tab?
edit.queryReadOnlyHint: To edit results, use a writable connection and select columns from one table, including its primary key.
edit.readOnlyHint: The table has no primary key: its rows cannot be told apart, so it cannot be edited here.
edit.addRowHint: Empty fields take the column default. Nothing is written until Apply.
edit.applyFirst: Apply or discard the pending changes first
edit.closeUnsavedMany_one: {{count}} tab has unsaved row changes ({{tabs}}). Discard them and close?
edit.closeUnsavedMany_other: {{count}} tabs have unsaved row changes ({{tabs}}). Discard them and close?

activeSchemaSet: Unqualified names are looked up in {{schema}} now

transaction.autoCommitHint: Each statement commits as it runs. Off: changes wait for Commit or Rollback.
transaction.autoCommitLocked: A transaction is open: commit or roll it back before turning auto-commit on.
transaction.smartCommitHint: Smart commit (from the connection's type): the first statement that changes data switches this tab to manual commit until you commit or roll back.
transaction.unsupported: Auto-commit only: this connection cannot tell whether a transaction is open.
transaction.openHint: A transaction is open on this tab: its changes are not visible to others until you commit.
transaction.failedHint: The transaction failed: the server will only roll it back.
transaction.lostWithTransaction: A transaction was open: the server rolled back what was not committed.

runOptions.title: Run options for this tab
runOptions.timeoutHint: Empty: the connection's statement timeout. 0: no limit in this tab.

scriptError.title: Statement {{index}} failed
scriptError.remaining_one: {{count}} statement after it has not run yet.
scriptError.remaining_other: {{count}} statements after it have not run yet.
scriptError.hint: Skip all goes on without asking again in this run.

export.title: Export result
export.allQuery: Every row: run the query again
export.allTable: Every row the filter keeps, in its order (every page)
export.newSession: It runs again in a new session, as a read, and is written straight to the file: it does not see this tab's temporary tables, SET values or uncommitted changes.
export.openTransaction: This tab has an open transaction: its uncommitted changes will not be in the file.
export.refused: Only the loaded rows can be exported: {{reason}}
export.noQuery: The query of this result is not known: only the loaded rows can be exported.
export.tablesHint: One file per table, named after it, in the folder you choose. Existing files are kept: a new name is used instead.
export.header: Column names as the first row
export.escapeHint: A text cell starting with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return gets a leading ' so a spreadsheet shows it instead of running it. Numbers are never changed.
export.replaced_one: {{formattedCount}} character the encoding lacks was written as ?.
export.replaced_other: {{formattedCount}} characters the encoding lacks were written as ?.
export.cancelledNoFile: Export cancelled: no file was written.
export.failedAgain: Running it again in a new session failed: {{reason}}

files.changedMessage: The file changed since this tab opened or saved it. Overwrite it with this tab's text, reload it from disk (this tab's unsaved changes are lost), or cancel.
files.deletedMessage: The file is no longer on disk. Save this tab's text there again?
files.encodingMessage: The file is in {{encoding}}, which cannot hold the character “{{character}}”. Save it as UTF-8 instead?
files.unsavedMessage_one: They are lost if you don't save them.
files.unsavedMessage_other: They are lost if you don't save them: {{names}}.
files.reloadMessage: This tab's unsaved changes are lost.

restore.connectionMissing: The connection “{{connection}}” no longer exists: choose another one to run this tab.
restore.fileMissing: The file is no longer on disk: this is the text the tab had, unsaved.
restore.fileUnreadable: The file could not be read ({{message}}): this is the text the tab had, unsaved.
restore.fileChangedOnDisk: The file changed on disk while the app was closed: these are your unsaved changes, and saving asks before overwriting it.
